params.name: pax
params.description: The pax configuration. Accepted values: 2000 for two adults, 2010 for two adults and one child, 2020 for two adults and two children.

params.description: Your agent code. Use the same for every request made.

params.name: fromid
params.description: The package id to start from. Items retrieved will have an id that comes after the given value when sorted in ascending order.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to return. Default: 100, maximum: 1000.

params.name: offset
params.description: Used for pagination. For performance reasons, do not use without adding other query parameters.

params.name: departurecode
params.description: Code of the departure airport. Any valid IATA airport code.

params.description: Date of departure. Date must be compatible with ISO 8601. Example: departuredate=2035-01-31

params.name: destinationcode
params.description: Code of the destination airport. Any valid IATA airport code.

params.name: duration

params.name: accommodationid
params.description: The id of the accommodation to retrieve.

params.name: maxdaystodeparture
params.description: Maximum number of days to departure. Items returned will have a departure date that is equal or fewer days away from today.

params.name: departuredatefrom
params.description: Date of departure. Date must be compatible with ISO 8601. Example: departuredatefrom=2035-01-31

params.name: departuredatetill

items.docs:
This endpoint returns all available packages.
Very important! Remember to add your own agent string {&agent=youragentstring} to the urlToBooking link in each package.

params.name: market
params.description: The source market code. Accepted values: dk, fi, no, se.

params.name: agent
params.description: Your agent code. This will be used for generating the url for the next request.

params.name: adults
params.description: Mandatory. Number of adults. Any integer between 1 and 6.

params.name: childAges
params.description: A comma separated string with child ages. No space after comma. Example: childAges=0,5,14. Age ranges are, infant: 0-1, child: 2-12, youth: 13-17, adults: 18+.

params.name: departureCode
params.description: Code of the departure airport. Any valid IATA airport code.

params.name: departureDate
params.description: Date of departure. Date must be compatible with ISO 8601. Example: departuredate=2035-01-31.

params.name: destinationCode
params.description: Code of the destination airport. Any valid IATA airport code.

params.name: returnDate
params.description: Date of return. Date must be compatible with ISO 8601. Example: returnDate=2035-01-31.

params.name: duration
params.description: Number of nights between departure date and return date.

params.name: oneWay
params.description: If true then only one way flights are returned, if false then one way flights are not returned. If omitted then all flights are returned.

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to return. Default: 100, maximum: 1000.

params.name: offset
params.description: Used for pagination. For performance reasons, do not use without adding other query parameters.

params.name: tuiOnly
params.description: If true returns flights from TUIfly Nordic and TUI Airways. If false or omitted returns all airlines.

params.description: The source market code. Accepted values: dk, fi, no, se.

items.docs: Get all locations for a specific market

params.name: agent
params.description:
Your agent code. Use the same for every request made.

Example - tui

params.name: market
params.description:
The source market code.

Accepted values: dk, fi, no, se.

params.name: adults
params.description:
Number of Adults in the request.

Accepted Values - 1 to 6

params.name: childages
params.description:
Ages of Children in the request separated by comma. If no children are sent in the request, this parameter should not be sent (or sent as ?childAges=).

For 2 children with age 5 and 7, the value should be 5,7.
Age ranges are, infant: 0-1, child: 2-12, youth: 13-17.

params.name: destinations
params.description:
The G- code value for each destination that is mapped through the locations endpoint.
Multiple destinations can be sent in the request separated by comma.

Example: G-000000234,G-000000256,G-000000293,G-000000293

params.name: arrivaldatefrom
params.description: Date of arrival from. Date must be compatible with ISO 8601. Example: arrivaldatefrom=2035-01-31

params.name: arrivaldateto
params.description:
Date of arrival to.
Date must be compatible with ISO 8601.

Example: arrivaldateto=2035-01-31

params.name: durations
params.description: A list of one or more stay durations. Example: 3,5,7,14

params.name: airportcodes
params.description:
A list of airportcodes separated by comma that are requested by user as Departure locations.

Example: ARN,GOT,CPH

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of items to return. Maximum: 100.
